title: Friday Night Magic 2012: card flavor text

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: A plane and power whose 'perfection' and service are invoked by its followers.

entities.name: Geth, Lord of the Vault
entities.description: A speaker who warns that truth is a weapon in enemies' hands.

entities.name: Goma Fada
entities.description: Nomads who move because the earth does.

entities.name: Azax-Azog, the Demon Thane
entities.description: A demon thane who serves Phyrexia.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: A protector whose blessed watch covers everything from the holy church to the sacred glade; her collar is the symbol of her church.

entities.name: Avacyn's Collar
entities.description: The symbol of Avacyn's church, hated by werewolves.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: Avacyn's church, symbolized by Avacyn's Collar.

entities.name: Hollowhenge
entities.description: A place whose murdered inhabitants linger as souls who impart their terror to the living.

entities.name: Blessed Sleep
entities.description: An eternal rest wished upon the worthy.

entities.name: Vy Covalt
entities.description: A member of the Mirran resistance who defies a monster.

entities.name: Mirran resistance
entities.description: A resistance fighting on in the spirit of Mirrodin.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A plane whose spirit the Mirran resistance vows will fight on.

events.summary: Vy Covalt defies a monster, declaring her flesh holds no secrets and that the spirit of Mirrodin will fight on.
events.quote: "My flesh holds no secrets, monster. The spirit of Mirrodin will fight on."

relations.quote: "You serve Phyrexia. Your pieces would better serve Phyrexia elsewhere."
especially Avacyn's Collar, the symbol of her church.
